settings.appearance_desc: Theme, surface mode and accent color
settings.layout_desc: Dashboard, card layout and display mode
settings.metadata_desc: IGDB, RAWG and SteamGridDB API keys
settings.startup_desc: Launch mode, behavior, maintenance and about
settings.paths_desc: Manage detected or manually configured paths.
settings.steam_root_desc: Root folder where steam.exe is located.
settings.temp_folder_desc: Location for downloads and ZIP extraction.
settings.steam_account_desc: Account credentials for achievement tracking and integrations.
settings.achievements_desc: Use Steam Web API to load achievement progress, badges and rarity. Requires API Key and SteamID64.
settings.achievements_warning: Fill in Steam Web API Key and SteamID64 below to enable achievement tracking.
settings.api_key_placeholder: Enter your Steam Web API key
settings.steam_id64_desc: Required with Steam Web API Key for per-user achievement progress.
settings.steam_id32_desc: Optional. Used for local Steam userdata paths.
settings.appearance_desc: Change the visual style of LumaForge.
settings.surface_style_desc: Defines how cards, panels and containers look.
settings.animations_desc: Control hero and game background transitions.
settings.ambient_note: The ambient background always uses the premium fade transition, regardless of this setting.
settings.ambient_desc: Show active game artwork (blurred) behind the interface.
settings.ambient_toggle_desc: Enable dynamic background across all screens.
settings.ambient_mode_desc: Show blurred artwork or the dominant color extracted from the image.
settings.ambient_intensity_desc: Controls how much the ambient background is shown and blurred.
settings.overlay_desc: Control how game session notifications are delivered.
settings.overlay_window_desc: Use a transparent always-on-top overlay window for notifications.
settings.hud_desc: Show a floating pill during gameplay with game info, elapsed time, and stop/resume buttons.
settings.native_notification_desc: Send a system notification when an achievement unlocks.
settings.achievement_overlay_desc: Show achievement unlocks in a transparent overlay window on top of the game.
settings.launcher_overlay_desc: Show launcher meta-achievements (streaks, playtime milestones) in the overlay.
settings.metadata_desc: Configure metadata sources to enrich your game information.
settings.igdb_desc: IGDB provides cover art and metadata enrichment. Requires Twitch Client ID and Client Secret.
settings.igdb_warning: Fill in both Client ID and Client Secret to enable IGDB artwork and metadata sources.
settings.rawg_desc: RAWG provides background artwork and metadata enrichment. Requires a free API key from rawg.io.
settings.rawg_warning: Add a RAWG API key to enable RAWG background artwork.
settings.sgdb_desc: SteamGridDB provides posters, heroes and logos for Library cards.
settings.sgdb_enable_desc: Use SteamGridDB to fetch posters, heroes and logos.
settings.sgdb_warning: Add a SteamGridDB API key to fetch artwork.
settings.sgdb_key_desc: Used to fetch native posters, heroes and logos.
settings.providers_downloads_desc: Configure sources LumaForge will use to search and download packages.
settings.integrations_desc: Control which game providers are active and where they appear.
settings.integrations_note: Disable an integration to stop its scans and hide its games. All data is preserved.
settings.detailed_logs_desc: Record installations, downloads, errors and paths.
settings.clean_temp_desc: Delete ZIPs and extracted folders when exiting.
settings.media_cache_desc: Controls how aggressively artwork and metadata are cached locally.
settings.startup_behavior_desc: Control how LumaForge starts and how the window behaves.
settings.default_launch_desc: Choose which interface opens when LumaForge starts.
settings.window_mode_desc: How the main window appears on launch.
settings.backup_description: Export your LumaForge settings, favorites, manual games, playtime and more. Import a backup to restore across devices.
settings.backup_local_desc: Export and import backup archives stored on this device.

wizard.welcome_desc: Your open-source game launcher with Steam integration, achievements, Debrid downloads, and more. Let's get you set up in just a minute.
wizard.welcome_note: All steps are optional — you can always configure later in Settings.
wizard.appearance_desc: Pick a theme, surface finish, and accent color. You can change these anytime.
wizard.steam_desc: Auto-detect your Steam installation and optionally add your Steam Web API key for achievements.
wizard.steam_api_desc: Enables achievement tracking, playtime stats, and automatic library sync. Your key stays local.
wizard.steam_api_placeholder: Enter your Steam Web API key
wizard.steam_api_link: Get your API key at steamcommunity.com
wizard.steam_id64_desc: Your 17-digit Steam ID for per-user achievement progress.
wizard.providers_desc: Add API keys for game package sources. These power game downloads and Lua scripts.
wizard.metadata_desc: Enhance your library with beautiful artwork and rich game metadata from these providers.
wizard.sgdb_desc: Curated cover art, hero images, logos, and icons for your game library.
wizard.igdb_desc: Rich game metadata — descriptions, genres, release dates, and cover art. Requires Twitch OAuth credentials.
wizard.rawg_desc: Background artwork and metadata enrichment for Store discovery sections.
wizard.tools_desc: Optional tools for DRM handling and offline game support. Install what you need.
wizard.tools_steam_root_warning: Steam root path must be configured in Step 3 to install tools.
wizard.ready_desc: Here's what you configured. You can always change these in Settings later.
wizard.ready_tip: You can re-run this wizard anytime from Settings → Startup & More → Run Setup Wizard.
